cases.name: CIF: catalog, labels, blur validation, correction and keyboard focus
CIF: submit focuses the first invalid field and never sends invalid data
CIF: country changes preserve text, revalidate and send the FR prefix-like key
CIF: duplicate message persists beside the field and preserves the whole form
CIF: server country error is associated with and focuses the country control
CIF: ACCOUNT_CREATION_PENDING shows the actual result and requires list review
CIF: ACCOUNT_CREATION_UNCONFIRMED shows the actual result and requires list review
CIF: ACCOUNT_CREATION_INACTIVE shows the actual result and requires list review
CIF: confirmed email failure shows fallback credentials; incomplete success never does
CIF: internal roles hide CIF and omit it from the request; role change resets country
CIF: pending accounts cannot change role or reactivate and deletion stays protected
CIF: list role transition refuses missing CIF before confirmation
CIF: long country hints and errors fit narrow phones
